title: Vegan Tofu Tacos with Bell Pepper, Lettuce, Avocado & Salsa

steps.text: Cut the tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Transfer to a large plate.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add bell pepper, onion, and garlic. Cook, stirring often, until softened, 4-5 minutes. (Reserve plate for the next step.)
Meanwhile, halve lettuce lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Transfer to the reserved plate.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and small dice. Add to the plate with the lettuce.
Crumble tofu into small pieces with your fingers and add to the skillet along with spices. Cook, stirring occasionally, until tofu is golden brown, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
Warm taco shells in the microwave if desired.
To serve, divide taco shells between plates. Fill with tofu mixture, salsa, lettuce, and avocado. Enjoy!
